description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called WiFiDirectActivity that uses WiFi Direct APIs to discover, connect, and manage peer-to-peer WiFi connections. It contains methods for initializing WiFi P2P, handling permissions, managing lifecycle events, and responding to user actions related to WiFi Direct functionality.

classes.name: WiFiDirectActivity
classes.description: An Activity class that facilitates WiFi Direct peer discovery, connection, and management for an Android app. It implements ChannelListener and DeviceActionListener interfaces to handle WiFi P2P channel events and user actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, registers intent filters, initializes WiFi P2P, and requests location permission if needed.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the WiFiDirectBroadcastReceiver to listen for WiFi P2P related broadcasts.

methods.name: resetData
methods.description: Clears the peer list and device details UI fragments when the WiFi P2P state changes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for WiFi Direct actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for enabling WiFi Direct and initiating peer discovery.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays details of a selected WiFi P2P device.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a WiFi P2P device with provided configuration.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the current WiFi P2P group and resets the UI.

methods.name: onChannelDisconnected
methods.description: Attempts to re-initialize WiFi P2P channel if it gets disconnected.

methods.name: cancelDisconnect
methods.description: Cancels ongoing connection requests or disconnects if already connected.

methods.name: initP2p
methods.description: Checks device capabilities and hardware support for WiFi Direct and initializes WifiP2pManager and Channel if supported.
